phase_title: Phase 15-1 / 15-2 への実測入力データエントリ受領設計
phase_purpose: Phase 16 実測入力データエントリ受領・検証層：人間レビュー入力（integrated_decision 判定、receiver_validator_permission 判定）のデータエントリを受け取り、受領記録を作成する流れを設計する
execution_context: reports-only design phase; design of data entry receipt workflow only, no actual data entry yet

governance.safety_rule: All blocked_actions remain strictly prohibited. Data entry receipt is design-only; no actual human review data entry occurs until Phase 16-1 design is approved. No app/tests implementation permitted until integrated_decision=GO and receiver_validator_implementation_permission=EFFECTIVE are both confirmed.
governance.hard_stop_condition: This phase is design-only. No actual data entry processing or storage is permitted.

data_entry_receipt_structure.receipt_purpose: Design of workflow for receiving Phase 15-1 and Phase 15-2 human review input data
data_entry_receipt_structure.receipt_timing: Following Phase 15-9 (Phase 15 completion) approval and human reviewer assignment

data_sources_to_receive.input_source: Phase 15-1 integrated_decision final actual measurement input
data_sources_to_receive.description: Human reviewer decision: integrated_decision should be GO or NO_GO
data_sources_to_receive.format_specification: Reference Phase 15-1 integrated_decision final actual measurement input format specification
data_sources_to_receive.delivery_channel: TBD by Phase 16-1 receipt design (email, form, API, etc.)

data_sources_to_receive.input_source: Phase 15-2 receiver_validator_permission final actual measurement input
data_sources_to_receive.description: Human reviewer decision: receiver_validator_implementation_permission should be EFFECTIVE or NOT_EFFECTIVE
data_sources_to_receive.format_specification: Reference Phase 15-2 receiver_validator_permission final actual measurement input format specification
data_sources_to_receive.delivery_channel: TBD by Phase 16-1 receipt design (email, form, API, etc.)

step_1_receipt_notification_and_channel_.action: Establish receipt channel (email, form submission, API endpoint, etc.)
step_1_receipt_notification_and_channel_.requirement: Channel must support authenticated receipt with timestamp and logging
step_1_receipt_notification_and_channel_.design_task: Document receipt channel details, access controls, audit trail capability
step_1_receipt_notification_and_channel_.outcome: Receipt channel ready for human reviewer data submission

step_2_human_reviewer_data_entry_and_sub.action: Human reviewer fills in Phase 15-1 and Phase 15-2 data entry forms and submits
step_2_human_reviewer_data_entry_and_sub.requirement: Data must match format specs from Phase 15-1 and Phase 15-2
step_2_human_reviewer_data_entry_and_sub.design_task: Design data entry form(s) with field validation, format checking, timestamp recording
step_2_human_reviewer_data_entry_and_sub.outcome: Data submitted to receipt channel with timestamp and reviewer authentication

step_3_receipt_acknowledgment_and_loggin.action: Receipt system logs arrival of data, records receipt timestamp, creates receipt record
step_3_receipt_acknowledgment_and_loggin.requirement: Receipt must be timestamped and logged with reviewer ID and submission details
step_3_receipt_acknowledgment_and_loggin.design_task: Design receipt acknowledgment workflow: confirm receipt to submitter, log to audit trail, store receipt metadata
step_3_receipt_acknowledgment_and_loggin.outcome: Receipt record created and filed for Phase 16-2 validation

step_4_receipt_record_storage_and_transf.action: Store receipt record in reports/ directory; prepare data for Phase 16-2 validation
step_4_receipt_record_storage_and_transf.requirement: Receipt record must be immutable and timestamped; data payload stored separately for validation
step_4_receipt_record_storage_and_transf.design_task: Design receipt record JSON structure; design data package format for Phase 16-2 transfer
step_4_receipt_record_storage_and_transf.outcome: Receipt record finalized; data ready for Phase 16-2 completeness and signature validation

elements.receipt_timestamp: ISO8601 datetime of receipt system recording
elements.reviewer_id: Identifier of human reviewer submitting data
elements.reviewer_authentication_method: How reviewer identity was verified (e.g., digital signature, OAuth token)
elements.phase_16_1_receipt_record_id: Unique ID for this receipt record

elements.data_received: boolean - whether Phase 15-1 data was submitted
elements.submission_timestamp: When data was submitted to receipt channel
elements.submission_format: Data format received (JSON, email body, form submission, etc.)
elements.data_payload_reference: Path or ID to stored Phase 15-1 data for Phase 16-2 validation
elements.preliminary_format_check: Quick check: does data appear to match Phase 15-1 format spec? (YES/NO/PARTIAL)
elements.format_check_notes: Any issues detected in initial scan

elements.data_received: boolean - whether Phase 15-2 data was submitted
elements.submission_timestamp: When data was submitted to receipt channel
elements.submission_format: Data format received (JSON, email body, form submission, etc.)
elements.data_payload_reference: Path or ID to stored Phase 15-2 data for Phase 16-2 validation
elements.preliminary_format_check: Quick check: does data appear to match Phase 15-2 format spec? (YES/NO/PARTIAL)
elements.format_check_notes: Any issues detected in initial scan

elements.both_received_at_same_timestamp: boolean - whether both arrived together or separately
elements.time_delta_minutes: If separate, minutes between Phase 15-1 and Phase 15-2 receipt (null if same)

elements.receipt_initiated_by: User or system that initiated receipt workflow
elements.preliminary_validation_performed_by: System or process that did initial format check
elements.prepared_for_phase_16_2_by: User/system that prepared data for Phase 16-2 validation
elements.prepared_timestamp: When data was prepared for Phase 16-2 transfer
elements.audit_trail_log_reference: Path to detailed audit log for this receipt

option_1_email_based_receipt.channel_type: Email submission with form attachment or body content
design_tasks: Create template for email body format
Create audit trail from email headers

option_2_form_portal_based_receipt.advantage: Structured input, client-side validation, clear submission record
design_tasks: Design form with fields matching Phase 15-1 and Phase 15-2 specs
Implement form validation (format, required fields, etc.)
Design submission confirmation and receipt number generation
Store form responses in database or file
Create audit log of form submissions

option_3_api_based_receipt.channel_type: REST or GraphQL API endpoint accepting structured input
option_3_api_based_receipt.advantage: Most structured, programmatic, audit trail native
option_3_api_based_receipt.disadvantage: Requires API development and reviewer tool integration
design_tasks: Define API endpoint for Phase 15-1 input POST
Define API endpoint for Phase 15-2 input POST
Implement request validation (schema, authentication, rate limiting)
Design response structure (receipt ID, confirmation, timestamp)
Implement API audit logging and retry handling

prerequisite_1_receipt_channel_operation.requirement: Receipt channel must be set up and accessible
prerequisite_1_receipt_channel_operation.check: Is receipt channel (email, form, API) ready to receive submissions?
prerequisite_1_receipt_channel_operation.halt_condition: No - halt Phase 16-1 execution until channel is operational

prerequisite_2_human_reviewer_assigned.requirement: At least one human reviewer must be assigned to Phase 15-1 and Phase 15-2 review
prerequisite_2_human_reviewer_assigned.check: Have reviewers been formally assigned and notified?
prerequisite_2_human_reviewer_assigned.proceed_condition: Yes - send reviewer guidelines and access to receipt channel
prerequisite_2_human_reviewer_assigned.halt_condition: No - halt Phase 16-1 execution until reviewers are assigned

prerequisite_3_phase_15_completion_confi.requirement: Phase 15 (all design phases 15-1 through 15-9) must be complete and approved
prerequisite_3_phase_15_completion_confi.check: Has Phase 15-9 completion declaration been reviewed and approved?
prerequisite_3_phase_15_completion_confi.proceed_condition: Yes - proceed with Phase 16-1 receipt design
prerequisite_3_phase_15_completion_confi.halt_condition: No - cannot proceed until Phase 15 approval is confirmed

depends_on: Phase 15: All design phases complete and approved
Phase 15-1: integrated_decision input format specification (reference for receipt)
Phase 15-2: receiver_validator_permission input format specification (reference for receipt)
feeds_into: Phase 16-2: Actual measurement input data completeness and validation (receives receipt record and data payload)
Phase 16-3: Pre-decision update feasibility assessment (receives validation results)

design_review_checklist: Receipt channel options documented with trade-offs
Phase 15-1 and Phase 15-2 required fields are clear and matched to format specs
Receipt workflow steps are sequential and have clear entry/exit criteria
Receipt record JSON structure captures metadata and audit trail
Preliminary format check procedure is defined (step 3)
Data transfer mechanism to Phase 16-2 is designed
Reviewer assignment and notification process is documented
Audit trail capability is specified for all receipt channels
All blocked actions remain in governance
Phase dependencies are accurate and complete

completion_gate.gate_condition: Receipt workflow design approved AND receipt channel option selected AND human reviewers assigned
completion_gate.approval_required: Human technical reviewer + Phase 16 design authority
completion_gate.prerequisite_for: Phase 16-2 (completeness and validation design) can begin once receipt design is approved
